transaction.serialization: locks authenticated t_user row before user/type upsert
transaction.save: base row and type-0 summary in one transaction
transaction.delete: base row deletion and requested-type summary reset in one transaction
transaction.failure: statistics insertion failure rolls back the preceding base-row insert

assertions: same user/type is overwritten rather than duplicated
type-0 totalTime is recalculated from persisted base data
requested type deletion removes only that type
requested type statistics are reset without changing other types
forced statistics constraint failure leaves no base row

known_boundary: The feature flag remains disabled; Java and Rust must never write this domain concurrently.
